development.rule: repository-stratified round robin after a seeded within-repo shuffle; selected first and excluded from the formal batch

formal.rule: repository-stratified round robin after a seeded within-repo shuffle; no difficulty stratification, no result-based selection

arms.role: full minus bounded tool previews and recall
full minus injected scoped project guidance

scoring.denominator: all planned tasks per arm; infrastructure failures stay in the main denominator and are listed separately
scoring.statistics: paired four-cell counts first; Wilson 95% interval per arm; exact two-sided McNemar for paired arms; small samples are descriptive only
scoring.failureTraces: first provider failure, first budget stop, first logically wrong completed episode with a non-empty patch; absent classes are reported as absent

manifest.authorization: not granted by this file; paid model calls require explicit user approval per batch
